The python-genai README recommends loading Gemini API Skills into assistants like Claude Code or Cursor to inject correct patterns into their context, which satisfies the agent-oriented-docs branch of the story. A probe found ai.google.dev/llms.txt returns 404; Google never claimed llms.txt support, so this is a gap rather than a dispute. missing for 10: an llms.txt file (probe 404), detail on what the skill contains and how it is delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use it effectively.
